basis: No capability is qualified for alerts today: the shipped capability registry (eligibility.json) has verdict NO-GO and enables no declaration. This is the intended v1 advisory scope; it becomes effective only through the M4 evaluation bound to an immutable spent population (valid-detection-benchmark tasks 11.6 and 11.7).

scope.label: injection
scope.reason: Injection entails with witnesses on the measured subjects.

scope.label: untrusted destination
scope.reason: Untrusted destination entails with witnesses on the measured subjects.

scope.label: configuration
scope.reason: Configuration entails with witnesses on the measured subjects.

exclusions.label: access control
exclusions.reason: Access control does not entail with witnesses on the measured subjects: on an application that splits its route from its data access the obligation is carried, and a carried obligation corroborates by design, so shipping the family would ship silence.
exclusions.not_told: No defect is reported for access control, so a contributor is not told that a change reaches a protected operation without the guard or ownership constraint its siblings carry, even when it does.

exclusions.label: output encoding
exclusions.reason: Has not earned a place through evaluation.
exclusions.not_told: No defect is reported for output encoding, so a contributor is not told that a change sends untrusted data to a rendered document or a header without encoding, even when it does.

exclusions.label: path
exclusions.reason: Has not earned a place through evaluation.
exclusions.not_told: No defect is reported for path, so a contributor is not told that a change lets untrusted input reach a filesystem path, even when it does.

exclusions.label: prototype
exclusions.reason: Has not earned a place through evaluation.
exclusions.not_told: No defect is reported for prototype, so a contributor is not told that a change lets untrusted keys reach an object merge or an attribute assignment, even when it does.

exclusions.label: deserialization
exclusions.reason: Has not earned a place through evaluation.
exclusions.not_told: No defect is reported for deserialization, so a contributor is not told that a change deserializes untrusted data into objects the process then trusts, even when it does.

exclusions.label: memory
exclusions.reason: No memory-safety capability has been evaluated: the only related declaration in the shipped capability registry (eligibility.json) is c/libpng/memory_safety, it is disabled with verdict NO-GO, and its family id memory_safety is not a taxonomy family.
exclusions.not_told: No defect is reported for memory, so a contributor is not told whether a memory-safety defect such as an out-of-bounds access exists in the change, even when it does.
